image_description: A surreal, black-and-white street scene featuring several pedestrians on a cobblestone plaza. Dominating the foreground is a massive, elongated, multi-lobed soap bubble with vivid iridescent colors (cyan, magenta, gold) that contrast sharply with the monochrome background. A smaller spherical bubble floats to the right. An orange object lies on the ground in the lower center.
